mechanism: Both drugs cause CNS depression through different mechanisms (GABA potentiation vs dopamine antagonism), with additive sedative and psychomotor effects; fluphenazine may inhibit diazepam metabolism via CYP3A4/2C19.
action: Use combination cautiously with dose reduction of diazepam; monitor for excessive sedation, respiratory depression, and orthostatic hypotension; educate patient on avoiding alcohol and hazardous activities.
